query: List my new vault check agent on the CAPPZ marketplace for 1 XRP. It's at https://node.example.com/agents/vault-check.
expected_behavior: Checks the agent exists first: GET <endpoint>/agent and /health answer on the network being listed
Confirms which CAPPZ_HOME session (seller account) and that a profile exists on that network
Lists the testnet twin first with its own testnet endpoint, hires it once, then asks the person before --network mainnet
Uses sell --category agents --kind service --endpoint <the agent's own url> with the price equal to the agent card's
Verifies with find and records the listing ids

query: We designed a new security service but haven't deployed it yet. Put it on the marketplace now so people can see it.
expected_behavior: Refuses to list something that does not run yet, or proposes deploying and testing it first
Explains that a listing is a promise buyers act on and contracts freeze its terms

query: Sell a monitoring service at 10 XRP a month on CAPPZ, recommend how to price and structure it.
expected_behavior: Structures one order as one period of at most 30 days, renewal as a new order
Recommends a price with reasoning (comparable listings, running cost and risk, value bounded) and leaves the decision to the person
Writes the description for people and agents with facts, not uptime guarantees
